infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Velocity needs access to your photos so you can share pictures in chat and upload verification documents.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Velocity needs camera access so you can take and share a photo in chat and capture verification documents.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Velocity uses your location to match nearby rides, enable live trip tracking, and share your location in chat.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Velocity lets you pick a contact to share their number in chat.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Velocity uses your microphone so you can book a ride by speaking instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Velocity turns your speech into a ride booking. Recognition happens on your device.
